environment.description: Service deployed as ECS Fargate task in 'payments' namespace on shared EKS cluster. Exposed via AWS ALB with path-based routing. No service mesh. All pods in the cluster can reach the service on port 8080. Step Functions workflow triggers callback to /internal/workflow/callback directly. DynamoDB table has no fine-grained access control - any caller with valid session_id can interact with any session.

config.network: Flat network, no NetworkPolicy, no service mesh
config.auth: X-User-Id header set by upstream API gateway (no signature verification)
config.exposure: ALB routes /api/* to service, /internal/* also reachable from within cluster
